name: Lower Body and Glutes
description: Four days a week for 10 weeks, three of them for the legs and glutes and one for the upper body. Hip thrusts, squats, deadlift variations and single-leg work make up the heavy part of each leg day; kickbacks, abductions and band walks finish it. Week 5 is a deload between the two blocks. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.
